name: Simbe AI Article Generator
author: simbe1

sections.description:
Simbe AI Article Generator helps you create high-quality, SEO-optimized articles for your WordPress site. Choose from 15 different writing styles and generate content that resonates with your audience.

Features

  • 15 Article Styles: Guide, Opinion, News, Tutorial, Listicle, Review, Story, Explainer, Case Study, Comparison, Trend, Problem-Solution, Beginner, Advanced, and Quick Tips
  • SEO Optimized: Generates title, meta description, and structured content
  • GEO Targeting: Add location context to your articles
  • AI Integration: Optional Groq API for enhanced AI-generated content (free tier available)
  • Model Selection: Choose your Groq AI model in Settings
  • Test Connection: Verify your Groq API key straight from the Settings screen
  • Front-End SEO: Optional meta description, keywords, and Open Graph tags, disabled automatically when a dedicated SEO plugin is active
  • Generation Tracking: See how many articles you’ve generated (with and without AI)
  • Generation History: Review your 20 most recent generations and jump straight to saved drafts
  • Live Word Count: Word count and reading time update as you edit
  • Draft Publishing: Save as a new draft, or update the one you already saved
  • Featured Images: Select cover images from Media Library
  • Defaults: Preset your preferred style and length so the form starts where you left off

External Services

This plugin optionally connects to the Groq API to generate AI-powered articles when the user configures a Groq API key in the plugin settings.

What data is sent:
– Article topic/title
– Selected article style (e.g., Guide, Tutorial, Review)
– Preferred length (short, medium, long)
– Location for GEO targeting (if provided)
– User’s Groq API key (for authentication)

When is data sent:
– Each time the user clicks “Generate Article” with AI enabled
– Only when the Groq API key is configured in plugin settings

Service provided by: Groq, Inc.
Terms of Service: https://groq.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://groq.com/privacy-policy

How It Works

  1. Enter your article topic or paste a reference URL
  2. Select an article style that fits your content needs
  3. Choose length (short, medium, or long)
  4. Optionally add location for GEO targeting
  5. Generate and preview your article
  6. Edit and save as draft to WordPress

AI Integration

The plugin works with or without AI. When a Groq API key is provided, it uses AI to generate more unique and contextually relevant content. Groq offers a free tier with 14,000 requests per month.

Donate

If you found this plugin useful, please consider making a donation to support further development.

Donate via PayPal
sections.installation:
1. Upload the simbe-ai-article-generator folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Navigate to AI Articles in your WordPress admin menu
  4. (Optional) Go to Settings and add your Groq API key
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No, the plugin works with built-in templates. However, for AI-generated content, you’ll need a free Groq API key from console.groq.com.

What are the article styles?

The plugin offers 15 styles:
* Guide – How-to and tutorials
* Opinion – Debatable topics with persuasive tone
* News – Current events reporting
* Tutorial – Step-by-step instructions
* Listicle – Top X format articles
* Review – Product comparisons and reviews
* Story – Personal experiences
* Explainer – Complex topics simplified
* Case Study – Real-world examples
* Comparison – Side-by-side evaluations
* Trend – Industry analysis
* Problem-Solution – Pain point focused
* Beginner – Entry-level content
* Advanced – Expert-level content
* Quick Tips – Bite-sized advice

Is there a daily limit?

No. The plugin does not impose a generation limit. If you rely on a metered AI API, keep an eye on your provider’s usage dashboard.

Does the Reference URL field rewrite the source page?

No. The plugin reads the page title to pre-fill your topic field, then writes the article from scratch using AI or the built-in templates. It does not copy or paraphrase the source page.

Is the content original?

Yes, the generated content is unique. When using AI, each generation produces different content. When using templates, the structure varies based on the style and inputs you provide.

Why are the meta description and Open Graph tags not showing?

Front-end SEO output is off by default so it never duplicates the tags from Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, or your theme. Enable it under AI Articles > Settings > Defaults & SEO Output.
sections.changelog:
4.3.0

  • NEW: Generation history table listing your 20 most recent generations, with a link to saved drafts
  • NEW: Live word count and reading time under the content editor
  • NEW: “Update Draft” so saving twice no longer creates duplicate posts
  • NEW: Keyboard shortcut (Ctrl/Cmd + Enter) to generate
  • NEW: Configurable default style and length in Settings
  • NEW: Optional front-end SEO output, off by default and auto-disabled when a dedicated SEO plugin is active
  • NEW: Proper plugin icon and banner, and screenshots renamed to WordPress.org’s required format
  • SECURITY: URL fetching now uses wp_safe_remote_get(), which re-validates every redirect hop (the previous guard could be bypassed by a redirect to an internal address)
  • SECURITY: Each AJAX action now has its own nonce instead of sharing one across all four
  • SECURITY: Request values are normalised before sanitising, so array payloads can no longer trigger a PHP 8 fatal error
  • SECURITY: Cover images are verified as image attachments before being attached
  • FIX: The length selector is no longer ignored when the AI response omits the content section
  • FIX: Template mode now varies meaningfully with the length setting instead of producing about 250 words every time. The 800/1500/2500 word targets are met by AI generation; template mode returns roughly 500/800/1150 words because the built-in section library is deliberately small. The length selector states this when no API key is configured.
  • FIX: The AI prompt now receives the human-readable style name and format hint instead of the internal style key
  • FIX: A failed database insert no longer writes orphaned post meta against post_id 0
  • FIX: Database schema upgrades now actually run (dbDelta could not parse the previous CREATE TABLE statement)
  • FIX: Inline error messages replace blocking alert() dialogs, and network failures no longer leave buttons stuck
  • IMPROVE: Word count handles CJK scripts correctly
  • IMPROVE: Cached table-existence check, plus indexes on the columns the stats query filters on
  • COMPAT: Tested up to WordPress 7.1; requires WordPress 6.0 or later
  • COMPAT: The Settings link is only shown to users who can actually reach the Settings page

4.2.0

  • NEW: Fully redesigned, modern Settings page with gradient header and connection status
  • NEW: “Test Connection” button to verify your Groq API key from Settings
  • NEW: Front-end SEO output – meta description, keywords, and Open Graph tags on posts
  • NEW: Choose your Groq AI model in Settings
  • FIX: User edits to the generated article are now saved (editable content box)
  • FIX: Meta keywords and source URL are now saved with the article
  • FIX: Meta description is also stored as the post excerpt
  • IMPROVE: Retry with backoff when Groq rate-limits or returns server errors
  • IMPROVE: Generation tracking now records every article (with AI usage flag)
  • IMPROVE: URL fetching blocks private/internal hosts (SSRF protection)
  • TUNE: Dynamic year in Trend-style meta descriptions
  • TUNE: Admin UI strings are translation-ready
  • REMOVE: Dead code (leftover DigitalEdu script, empty stylesheet)

4.1.0

  • Replaced Font Awesome with built-in Dashicons (faster, no external requests)
  • Moved inline styles to CSS file for cleaner code
  • Added Settings link on Plugins page
  • Surface Groq API error messages in UI
  • Removed Font Awesome CDN dependency
  • Code cleanup and optimization

4.0.1

  • Hotfix release for the 4.0.0 UI redesign

4.0.0

  • Complete UI redesign
  • Added 15 article styles
  • GEO location targeting
  • Reference URL field for quickly filling in a topic from a page title
  • Media library integration for cover images

1.0.0

  • Initial release
